subject.title: fix(telegram): Allow multi-agent ACP bindings within same account

question: Should same-account ACP binds in one Telegram topic create multiple independently routable bindings, or should the newest bind intentionally replace the prior same-account binding?
rationale: The PR description asks for independent multi-agent sessions, but the implementation and test assert last-writer-wins; choosing the permanent routing model is a product/session-state decision before a correct repair can be completed.

options.title: Implement Independent Bindings
options.body: Preserve plugin-state storage and change the binding key/routing model so same-account agents can coexist without losing the earlier session.

options.title: Define Same-Account Handoff
options.body: Keep one binding per account/topic, but retitle and test the behavior as an explicit ownership switch instead of independent sessions.

options.title: Pause For Live Repro
options.body: Wait for real Telegram proof that distinguishes the reported workflow from current main before deciding the binding model.

recommendation.title: Implement Independent Bindings
recommendation.body: Preserve plugin-state storage and change the binding key/routing model so same-account agents can coexist without losing the earlier session.

likelyOwner.reason: The storage contract and database-first migration direction for this path trace most clearly to steipete's recent Telegram plugin-state refactor history.
